orcaInp.studio.calcGlobs.description: Globs (relative to each workspace folder) of calculation results the Studio's Calculations tab scans: PySCF geom_NNNN/result.json sets, ORCA .out files, and other .json files with a boolean "converged" key. Paths matching orcaInp.runs.exclude are skipped.

notes: Redirect orcaInp.neaOverview to the Calculations tab: openStudio(extensionUri, 'calcs', { folder: <absolute folder path> }) — the folder is the NEA working directory (what runFolder(uri) returns today; a file path is also accepted, its directory is used). The tab scopes the scan to that folder and selects its first calculation set; the folder must lie inside a workspace folder (folders outside the workspace are only accepted after 'Add folder…'). Host methods on channel 'calcs': scan, group, problems, failedList, addFolder, settings; events: 'progress', 'changed'. The tab reuses orcaInp.runs.exclude (findFiles' default exclude) and needs no new commands.
